levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the four categories (identification, records, registration, responsibilities) is missing from the checklist.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four categories are represented on the checklist.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The checklist is organized clearly enough to actually be reused later, not just a list of notes.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: An item is marked 'verified' without the learner being able to name the actual real source checked.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every 'verified' item names the real source that was actually checked, and unverified items are honestly marked as such.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection shows genuine understanding of why an honestly incomplete checklist is more trustworthy than a falsely complete one.

lookFors: Every 'verified' item names an actual real source, not a guess dressed up as a fact.
At least one item is honestly marked 'not yet verified' if a real check genuinely wasn't possible — this is expected, not penalized.
No specific real legal fact is asserted anywhere as universally true.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
